name: SDN HTTP Route
description: Single-purpose flow node: parses one $HTQ HttpRequest envelope into one routing-decision JSON frame. All HTTP semantics live inside the module (TRUE isomorphism): URL path suffix matching ('/omm/bulk' -> omm_bulk, '/query' -> data_query, else not_found), query-string parsing (epoch as RFC3339 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ' or unix-seconds number; mode|profile; limit; source; format defaulting to 'flatbuffer'), case-insensitive If-None-Match header extraction, and POST body passthrough for data_query SQL. Decision frame contract (UTF-8 JSON bytes, aligned-binary wire format): {"route":"omm_bulk"|"data_query"|"not_found","format":"flatbuffer"|"json"} always present; "ifNoneMatch":"<verbatim header>" only when the request carried If-None-Match; "query":{"schema":"OMM.fbs","source"?,"profile"?,"epoch"?:<unix-seconds number>,"limit"?:<positive integer>} only when route=omm_bulk (absent keys defer to the retrieval module's config/compiled defaults); "sql":"...","params":[...] only when route=data_query (body is either a JSON object {"sql","params"} passed through or raw SQL text; a data_query request without a SQL body degrades to route=not_found); "error":"..." only when route=not_found. Exactly one decision frame is emitted per request.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Canonical WASM-served HTTP request envelope ($HTQ, module-sdk schemas/HttpRequestAbi.fbs): METHOD, PATH (no query string), QUERY (raw, URL-encoded), HEADERS (sorted, lower-cased names), BODY, REMOTE.

inputPorts.description: One HTTP request envelope as delivered verbatim by the host pipe.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Routing-decision frame: UTF-8 JSON bytes carried with the aligned-binary wire format (alignment 1). See the module description for the exact JSON contract. SDK manifest rules cannot express a JSON-bytes type, so the port declares the generic flatbuffer ref; runtime frames carry aligned-binary TAB descriptors.

outputPorts.description: Exactly one routing-decision JSON frame per request.

methods.description: Parses the $HTQ request (path suffix routing, query-string parameters, If-None-Match, data_query SQL body passthrough) and emits exactly one routing-decision JSON frame.
